element.name: Ruptured Earth
element.supports: Wizard, Damaging Spell, Spell Saving Throw

description.p: Choose a point on the ground you can see within range. The earth there splits and heaves upward in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 Bludgeoning damage and falling Prone on a failed save, or taking half as much damage without falling Prone on a successful one.
The broken, jagged ground in the area becomes Difficult Terrain until cleared away, which takes roughly 10 minutes of labor per 10-foot section.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3.

setters.set: sphere, dexterity, save, bludgeoning, damage, prone, difficult terrain, upcasting, higher-level spell slot
